text:
Platinum Price in 2024
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2024, the LBMA platinum price fell 1.2% between 2024-01-31 ($924) and 2024-12-30 ($913). The highest sampled price was $1,048 in May and the lowest was $887 in February. The mean of these observations was $955. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
